known_native_blockers: The current add_osim CustomJoint importer expands the one-DOF SimmSpline knees into independent D6 axes (27 Newton DOFs versus 23 source coordinates).
Predictive articulated dynamics must not use that approximate joint map; a native single-coordinate coupled knee transform/Jacobian/bias implementation is required.
A predictive MTP policy must explicitly choose weld or a +/-30 degree DOF with passive -25*q-2*qdot mechanics.
Native RRA and CMC tools are not implemented; official runs remain offline oracles.

policy.oracle: Official OpenSim and newton.opensim compatibility computations are offline references only and are forbidden in FD-1/FD-2 runtime dependency manifests.
policy.production_runtime: After conversion, simulation must use neutral newton.ModelBuilder, Model, State, Contacts, CollisionPipeline, and solver APIs.
policy.source_conversion: OpenSim-compatible formats and exact source kinematics may be used only before the sealed neutral artifact boundary.
